heading: EPFO CBT Meeting: Key Discussions on EPS & Retirement Withdrawals
tldr: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation's Central Board of Trustees (CBT) is convening today, November 19, 2026, in New Delhi.
A primary item on the agenda is the potential proposal to increase the minimum monthly pension under the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS).
The meeting is also expected to delve into discussions about providing subscribers with more flexible retirement withdrawal options.
Decisions from this 240th CBT meeting could significantly impact the financial planning and social security of millions of Indian workers.
These discussions reflect ongoing efforts to enhance the adequacy and accessibility of retirement benefits for EPF members.
caption:
Big news for your retirement savings! Today, a key meeting is happening about your Provident Fund (PF). They're talking about possibly increasing your minimum monthly pension and making it easier to take out your money when you retire. These changes could make a real difference to your future financial security. Learn more about what this means for you by reading the full article.
